title: Clamp and swap in place
description:
Write two small functions that change their caller's variables through references.

- `clampInPlace(value, low, high)` changes `value` so it is no less than `low` and no more than `high`. Assume `low <= high`.
- `orderPair(a, b)` swaps `a` and `b` if needed so that afterwards `a <= b`.

Neither returns anything. Do not use pointers.
hints: The starter's parameters are copies, so changes are lost when the function returns. One character per parameter fixes that.
